summary: The earthquake caused widespread destruction in the region and keeps thousands of people in shelters.

title: Humanitarian aid continues in Kumamoto with the sending of resources and the prime minister's visit
summary: Assistance efforts focus on distributing supplies and taking measures against the heat for evacuees.

title: A 70-year-old woman dies from possible heatstroke in a car after the Kumamoto earthquake

summary: The blast affected surrounding homes and mobilized emergency services.

title: Japan faces extreme temperatures of up to 40 degrees and risk of heatstroke
summary: Authorities urge extreme caution and also monitor the risk of landslides in the northeast.

title: Two-year-old boy missing in Okayama found safe and sound on a mountain
summary: The child was located by police after getting lost while his grandmother worked in the garden.

title: United States resumes bombings against Iran and Tehran promises retaliation
summary: Hostilities intensify and fears grow of a regional escalation in the Middle East.

title: Trump agrees to cancel the large-scale attack on Iran
summary: The U.S. president announced in a post that the planned operation will not be carried out.

title: New 4.7-magnitude aftershock in Kumamoto as seismic activity continues

title: Former mayor and new candidates vie for the Wakayama mayoralty

title: Typhoon 13 moves westward and could affect Okinawa and Kyushu
